jobs.jobDescription:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

About The Role

As the Senior Director of Enterprise Sales at Dandy you will build and lead an exciting new motion aimed at bringing our world-class dental lab solution to large dental practices (DSOs) and enterprise clients. In this role, you will own the GTM strategy for this motion and be responsible for winning business and building enduring relationships anchored in real value for clients. The Senior Director of Enterprise Sales is responsible for top-down relationship building and selling, and will lead a team of Managers, Account Executives and BDRs who will sell into clients top down and bottom up. This leader will partner cross-functionally with our Post Sales teams (Customer Onboarding/Training, Account Management), Marketing, Product, RevOps, Data, and Technology, to deliver strong value to customers and continue to iterate on solutions that best serve this exciting new segment. This role reports into the Head of Global DSO.

Responsibilities

  • Develop a deep understanding of enterprise dental groups to identify their unique needs and challenges, effectively demonstrating how Dandy can enhance operational efficiency, improve patient care, and drive revenue growth

  • Build and execute a comprehensive GTM strategy for Dandy’s Enterprise Sales segment, targeting DSOs, DPOs and large dental practices

  • Prospect and engage with enterprise groups, driving interest and pipeline for new business opportunities

  • Build, manage, and inspire a high-performing Enterprise Sales team, including Enterprise Account Executives and BDRs, to deliver against ambitious revenue and growth targets.

  • Create and refine the enterprise sales playbook, including strategies for top-down selling, multi-location contracting, and deal negotiation for enterprise groups

  • Develop and execute strategic account growth plans that address the unique needs of enterprise clients, navigating complex organizations and building relationships across C-suite executives, regional managers, and practice operators

  • Serve as the primary driver of enterprise deal negotiations, balancing client needs with Dandy’s business objectives to secure enduring, high-value partnerships

  • Collaborate with Post Sales teams to ensure smooth onboarding, effective training, and successful handoffs that drive long-term client success

Requirements

  • 10+ years sales experience with at least 5+ years of enterprise sales experience; must use a consultative selling approach and be comfortable navigating through multiple layers of an organization (C-suite, regional managers, individual practice owners)

  • 5+ years prior management experience required

  • 2+ years of second line leadership experience required

  • You have a firm understanding of macro business fundamentals as well as the constraints, challenges and joys of running small businesses. Your skillset allows you to quickly switch between discussing ROI with the COO and discussing staffing challenges with a dental practice clinician

  • Must be comfortable traveling across the US – frequent travel to prospect meetings is expected

  • Must be truly customer-centric – Dandy is here to improve how dental practice organizations work with their lab partners and we are constantly innovating new ways to better serve our customers

  • Must possess excellent written/verbal communication and presentation skills

  • Experience in the dental industry as well as experience with high velocity selling is a plus

Req ID: J-1260

For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Dandy also fully complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals. If you require any accommodations for your interview or have any questions beforehand, rest assured that we will do everything we can to meet your needs. Visit Dandy Careers for more!

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you consent to Dandy collecting, storing, and processing your personal information for recruitment purposes in accordance with our Privacy Policy and GDPR regulations. You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your data at any time by contacting Privacy Requests.

jobs.jobDescription:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role:

Veeam, following its acquisition of Securiti AI - the leader in AI-powered data security posture management (DSPM) - is seeking experienced Sales Specialists to drive growth in this innovative business.

In this role, you will focus exclusively on Securiti AI solutions, working closely with Veeam account executives to cross-sell into Veeam’s customer base, win new business, and expand existing Securiti AI accounts. You’ll have a shared territory with multiple AEs, strong earning potential, and support from a dedicated Securiti AI solution engineer for technical engagements. You’ll also benefit from Veeam’s robust go-to-market resources to ensure customer success.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute a territory plan to drive repeatable revenue within assigned accounts.
  • Collaborate with account executives to identify and maximize cross-sell opportunities for Securiti AI solutions.
  • Lead the entire sales process, serving as a trusted advisor, and presenting compelling business cases to customers.
  • Manage a pipeline of high-value opportunities, ensuring accurate forecasting and CRM discipline.
  • Expand relationships with key channel partners and resellers to accelerate deal flow and market reach.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven success closing complex enterprise software deals, with 10-15+ years in security software sales.
  • Extensive experience managing multithreaded sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong existing relationships with C-suite executives and channel partners in large enterprises.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise software sales, particularly in data security, management, or cybersecurity.
  • Reputation for integrity, honesty, and building long-term customer relationships.
#LI-JC3

jobs.jobDescription:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

You'll be the go-to deal desk and pricing expert for ElevenLabs' North American sales team -- the person that the sales team comes to when a deal is complex, competitive, or needs to move fast. You'll own pricing strategy and deal structuring for our most critical customers, partnering with stakeholders to get non-standard terms across the line, and build the processes that make the whole machine run faster.

  • Own the pricing and deal structure for complex enterprise deals, advising sales on commercials and trade-offs in real time to keep things moving toward close.

  • Work closely with engineering to maintain and evolve our Configure Price Quote tool.

  • Translate customer requirements into deal structures that work commercially and operationally, knowing where to flex and where to hold firm.

  • Own the path through internal complexity, aligning Finance, Legal, Product, and leadership so deals don't stall on process.

  • Partner with Finance to build deal-level P&L models and communicate pricing trends back to the business, informing strategic pricing decisions at the leadership level

  • Develop and maintain pricing frameworks, discount guardrails, and approval policies that scale with the business.

  • Build the analytics and feedback loops that surface where deals are slowing down and why — and fix it.

Requirements

  • Hands‑on experience configuring and maintaining CPQ rulesets, price books, and approval workflows.

  • Experience in finance or deal pricing at a company, or experience within investment banking or management consulting

  • Excellent financial modeling, verbal, and written communication skills

  • Proven track record of process optimizations or automation.

  • Ability to make value judgements that balance business, financial, and legal priorities.

Bonus:

  • Knowledge of AI/ML industry pricing models and competitive landscape

  • Experience scaling deal desk processes in a high-growth environment

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.jobDescription:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

Dandy is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy and development of our Crown and Bridge customer experiences. Today, our internal design team uses sophisticated first-party CAD software to design every crown. Your job is to bring the right parts of that process to the dentist, so they can influence the outcome with confidence.

Reporting to the GM of Crown and Bridge, you will define and build experiences like interactive 3D design previews, live design reviews with our technicians, and real-time AI crown generation at the chairside, all in service of one goal: the perfect crown for fit, function, and aesthetics.

What You'll Do

Product development at Dandy is a collaborative, high-impact function. You’ll serve as the connective tissue between design, engineering, operations, and business leadership to drive both strategy and execution.

  • Drive the roadmap for your area. You'll ramp by working across Crown and Bridge, then own a defined scope, such as our bridge product, veneers, or a piece of the chairside ordering experience, and set its direction.

  • Bridge internal and external. Build a deep understanding of how our design team works so you can translate a complex internal process into an experience that feels intuitive to a dentist.

  • Lead cross-functionally. Align CAD Engineering, ML, UX Design, and Manufacturing so that what the doctor sees on screen is exactly what gets produced.

  • Ground decisions in evidence. Run customer discovery, market research, and competitive analysis to shape the roadmap and surface new opportunities.

  • Ship into a real operation. Manage the full lifecycle from idea through launch and iteration, knowing that every release lands in a live lab with real technicians, real production schedules, and real cases in flight. You'll plan rollouts, train teams, and adapt quickly when the physical world pushes back.

  • Measure and refine. Combine quantitative data with qualitative insight to assess impact, communicate results, and adjust course.

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for creative and curious product thinkers who can develop and grow a compelling vision for Dandy's products. We seek an experienced Senior or Principal Product Manager accustomed to working in a hyper-growth, customer obsessed organization.

  • 6+ years of experience in product management, managing software products through the full lifecycle from MVP to general release and subsequent iterations

  • Tech Driven Physical Product or Operational Experience: experience working with software experiences that influence real world movement or a physical product

  • High Bias-to-Action: You thrive in hyper-growth environments and are comfortable moving from high-level strategy to "nitty-gritty" specs in the same afternoon.

  • Clinical Empathy: You are obsessed with the end-user. You want to spend time in dental offices understanding how a doctor wants to interact with software experiences that ultimately get them the physical product they like.

Bonus Points For

  • Industry Context: Previous experience in Dental, MedTech, or other operationally complex, tech driven product.

Req ID: J-125

For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Dandy also fully complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals. If you require any accommodations for your interview or have any questions beforehand, rest assured that we will do everything we can to meet your needs. Visit Dandy Careers for more!

You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your data at any time by contacting Privacy Requests.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

Kaseya is seeking a proactive, highly organized, and business-minded Executive Assistant to support a senior executive. This individual will operate with a high degree of discretion, professionalism, and judgment, helping the executive maximize their time, focus, and impact across a fast-paced, high-growth organization.

The ideal candidate is more than an administrative support professional. They are proactive, anticipate needs, understand business priorities, effectively manage competing demands, and ensure the executive is prepared for critical meetings, decisions, and commitments. They are comfortable operating independently, adapting to changing priorities, and building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

The successful candidate will leverage modern productivity tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to enhance executive effectiveness, streamline administrative processes, improve information management, and increase efficiency. They should be comfortable incorporating AI into daily workflows to reduce manual effort, improve the quality of deliverables, and support effective decision-making.

The Executive Assistant will work closely with senior leadership and key stakeholders and may support interactions with Kaseya's leadership team, Board members, investors, and other high-profile individuals. Experience supporting senior executives in a private equity-backed or high-growth technology organization is highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide proactive administrative and operational support to a senior executive, managing priorities, time, information, and relationships.
  • Manage a complex and dynamic executive calendar, ensuring time is aligned with business priorities and high-value activities.
  • Anticipate scheduling conflicts, preparation requirements, information gaps, and follow-up needs before they become issues.
  • Serve as a professional liaison between the executive and internal and external stakeholders, exercising sound judgment regarding priorities, access, and communication.
  • Coordinate meeting logistics, agendas, pre-reads, presentations, briefing materials, and other preparation requirements.
  • Organize executive leadership meetings, Board meetings, investor engagements, and other high-priority business activities, as applicable.
  • Track key decisions, action items, and commitments, proactively following up with stakeholders to ensure accountability and completion.
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel, including detailed itineraries, logistics, and last-minute changes.
  • Draft, edit, and coordinate executive communications, presentations, and other business materials with professionalism and attention to detail.
  • Leverage AI-powered tools to assist with meeting preparation, summarizing information, drafting communications, organizing notes, tracking action items, and streamlining administrative tasks.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to reduce repetitive work, improve workflows, and increase productivity.
  • Stay informed about emerging AI capabilities and productivity tools relevant to executive support.
  • Use AI tools responsibly, maintaining confidentiality and following company policies regarding data security and approved technology.
  • Handle confidential, sensitive, and business-critical information with exceptional discretion and judgment.
  • Build strong working relationships across the organization and effectively coordinate with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Support special projects and business initiatives by coordinating stakeholders, managing timelines, organizing information, and tracking deliverables.
  • Identify opportunities to improve executive effectiveness, team communication, and administrative processes.
  • Represent the executive with professionalism, responsiveness, and sound judgment in all interactions.

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8 years of experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similar administrative support role, preferably supporting senior leaders.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting VP-level, C-suite, or other senior executives in a fast-paced organization.
  • Proven ability to anticipate executive needs, manage competing priorities, and proactively drive follow-through.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage complex calendars, multiple stakeholders, and changing priorities.
  • Experience using AI-powered tools or modern productivity technology to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, or enhance the quality of work.
  • Familiarity with generative AI tools for meeting summaries, research, content creation, communication drafting, or administrative support.
  • Ability to evaluate AI-generated content for accuracy and use AI tools responsibly while protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with executives, employees, and external stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to handle sensitive information with discretion.
  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of responsibilities, and make decisions without constant direction.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to remain composed and effective in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, Zoom, and other executive productivity and collaboration tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a C-suite executive or senior leader in a global organization.
  • Experience in a private equity-backed organization or high-growth technology or SaaS company.
  • Experience coordinating Board meetings, Board materials, investor meetings, or other executive-level engagements.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-powered productivity tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or comparable generative AI platforms.
  • Experience identifying opportunities to improve administrative processes through automation or technology.
  • Experience supporting executives through organizational growth, transformation, or change.
  • Experience working across multiple time zones and supporting globally distributed teams.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who We Are

Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Vultr Cares

  • 100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans.

  • 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting

  • Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year

  • 11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan

  • Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year

  • $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year

  • Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month

  • Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month

  • Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a highly skilled and experienced GPU Solutions Engineer to lead customers designing, implementing, and optimizing solutions on Vultr’s GPU platform. This role partners closely with Direct Sales, Customer Success, Product Management, Engineering and Support Departments to bring AI, ML, GPU workloads to life. The ideal candidate is technically strong and highly collaborative. You have significant hands on experience in cloud infrastructure, networking, Kubernetes and modern GPU computing architectures. You are comfortable translating complex technical concepts into clear solutions, solving real-world challenges, guiding customers from initial design into production and collaborating internally and externally. This is a highly visible role in a high-growth technology company, which will require strong problem-solving skills, customer engagement, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment. You will directly influence customer adoption and the overall experience on Vultr’s platform. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engage collaboratively with customers to understand their objectives.

  • Create innovative Solutions and Architectures to solve complex Customer use cases.

  • Establish relationships within Customers independent of Account Executives.

  • Educate customers on the value that Vultr provides and expand their horizons about the art of the possible.

  • Participate in deep architectural discussions and design exercises to create world-class solutions at Vultr.

  • Collaborate with Engineering and Product Management to deliver Voice of the Customer to guide Product and Feature development.

  • Lead resolution of complex customer challenges.

  • Partner with Marketing to create reference architectures, white papers, workshops, and demonstrations for internal and external uses.

  • Travel 25%

Qualifications

  • Highly motivated / self-starter with a sense of ownership, willingness to learn, and desire to succeed.

  • A collegial and collaborative approach working across Departments and Seniority levels within Vultr’s Customers and Vultr.

  • Skilled at influencing, guiding, and facilitating stakeholders and peers with decision making.

  • Ability to articulate technical and business concepts to diverse stakeholders.

  • Demonstrated willingness and ability to dig into unfamiliar territories to solve complex challenges.

  • Experience with structured sales engagement models MEDDPIC, Sandler, BANT, etc.

  • Expertise in the GPU ecosystem from GPU Hardware, Bare Metal and Virtualized Cloud Delivery, AL & ML frameworks and AI & ML Ops orchestration.

  • Extensive knowledge of AI Models / Algorithms, Libraries, Compilers and Runtimes for diverse silicon ecosystems.

  • GPU benchmarking and workload testing experience.

  • Demonstrated experience with workload orchestration, Kubernetes and Slurm.

  • System and Cluster level understanding of x86 server hardware architecture and Linux OS.

  • Hands on with Infrastructure as Code methodologies including, Terraform, Ansible, etc.

  • Networking experience, including knowledge of Infiniband, RoCE / UEC Ethernet, or other networking protocols.

  • NCCL / RCCL performance optimization.

  • High Performance Storage experience, knowledge of performant multi-user offerings including Open Source and COTS options.

  • 5+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructure experience

  • 4+ years of Solution Engineering, Sales Engineering, Professional Services or Consulting experience

  • 3+ year of experience deploying GPU-based AI, ML & Analytics solutions (e.g., for Training, Inference, Fine Tuning, Reinforcement Learning, Agentic Harnesses)

Compensation

$180,000 - $200,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws.

Inclusion & Privacy

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and experiences, and we prohibit discrimination based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable laws. Vultr will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with applicable laws and will not conduct a background check until after an offer of employment has been extended and accepted.

We also take your privacy seriously. We handle personal information responsibly and follow applicable laws, including U.S. privacy rules and India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023. Your data is used only for legitimate business purposes and is protected with proper security measures.

Where allowed by law, applicants may request details about the data we collect, access or delete their information, withdraw consent for its use, and opt out of nonessential communications. For more details, please see our Privacy Policy.

About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

The Director of Program Management, Global Events will lead the program management function within Kaseya's Global Events organization. This role owns how Kaseya's global event portfolio is planned, governed, resourced, and measured, turning strategy into an integrated, predictable, and scalable operating model across every region and event type.

Reporting directly to the Vice President of Global Events, this leader will oversee the end-to-end program management of Kaseya's flagship conferences, regional events, executive experiences, customer and partner programs, sales kickoffs. The role leads a team of event program managers, sets the standards and tools they use, and connects Events with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Product, Finance, and Leadership, ensuring every program is delivered on time, on budget, and with measurable business impact.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Strategy & Planning

  • Partner with the VP of Global Events to translate the global event strategy into an integrated annual and multi-year portfolio plan.
  • Own the global events calendar, balancing business priorities, regional needs, budget, and team capacity.
  • Lead event intake, business case review, and prioritization, ensuring every investment is tied to clear objectives such as pipeline, customer retention, and brand.
  • Run portfolio planning and business reviews with senior stakeholders, recommending where to invest, scale, consolidate, or retire programs.

Program Governance & Operating Model

  • Build and lead the Events Program Management team, defining the frameworks, phase gates, and decision rights used to deliver every event.
  • Create standardized playbooks, templates, timelines, RACI models, and run-of-show standards that scale across event types and regions.
  • Establish a consistent planning cadence, including status reporting, risk reviews, and executive checkpoints, that gives leadership clear visibility across the portfolio.
  • Drive continuous improvement through post-event retrospectives, lessons learned, and process optimization.

Cross-Functional Program Leadership

  • Lead complex, multi-workstream programs such as flagship conferences and global sales kickoffs, coordinating content, registration, marketing, sales, production, logistics, and executive involvement.
  • Align stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal, and regional teams on scope, timelines, and success criteria.
  • Manage dependencies, critical paths, and scope changes across concurrent programs, escalating and resolving issues quickly.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive stakeholders, providing clear recommendations and tradeoffs.

Budget, Resource & Vendor Management

  • Own consolidated financial management for the global events portfolio, including multimillion-dollar budgeting, multi-currency forecasting, and variance reporting.
  • Lead resource and capacity planning across the program management team, agencies, and freelance partners.
  • Drive global sourcing strategy and lead negotiations with venues, agencies, production partners, and suppliers, using portfolio scale to improve value.
  • Establish vendor performance standards, service levels, and scorecards to ensure exceptional delivery.

Systems, Data & Reporting

  • Own the events technology and tooling roadmap, including project management, registration, event platforms, and their integration with CRM and marketing automation.
  • Define and track portfolio KPIs includes budget adherence, attendee satisfaction, pipeline contribution, revenue influence, and event ROI.
  • Deliver executive dashboards and portfolio reporting with actionable recommendations.
  • Use data and insights to improve planning accuracy, operational efficiency, and business outcomes.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing global team of event program managers.
  • Define roles, career paths, and competency standards for event program management.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and operational discipline.
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentorship, succession planning, and professional development.

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in event program management, event operations, or a related program management role, including 5+ years leading teams.
  • 10+ Proven success managing a global portfolio of large-scale conferences, customer and partner events, executive programs, sales kickoffs, and trade shows across multiple regions.
  • 10+ Demonstrated experience building or leading a PMO, or establishing program governance, standardized processes, and scalable operating models.
  • 5+ Experience owning multimillion-dollar budgets, multi-currency forecasting, contract negotiations, and vendor partnerships.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Event Management, or a related field.
  • Experience within technology, cybersecurity, IT services, or high-growth organizations.
  • Advanced proficiency with project and portfolio management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Asana, Monday.com, Jira), event management platforms (e.g., Cvent), and CRM and marketing automation systems (e.g., Salesforce, Marketo, HubSpot).
  • Strong knowledge of international event logistics, risk management, and compliance requirements.
  • Exceptional program management skills, including planning, prioritization, dependency management, and risk mitigation across concurrent programs.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, often without direct authority.
  • Experience leading distributed teams in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company.

Vultr Cares

  • 100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental and vision plans.

  • 401(k) plan that matches 100% up to 4%, with immediate vesting

  • Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year

  • 11 Holidays + Paid Time Off Accrual + Rollover Plan

  • Commitment matters to Vultr! Increased PTO at 3 year and 10 year anniversary + 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years + Anniversary Bonus each year

  • $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year + $400 each following year

  • Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month

  • Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month

  • Company paid Wellable subscription

Join Vultr

Vultr is seeking a GTM Engineer to sit at the intersection of Demand Generation and Revenue Operations — building, executing, and optimizing the systems that power our go-to-market motion. The ideal candidate is a builder with deep hands-on experience across Clay, Salesforce, and outbound automation platforms who brings strong B2B sales copywriting instincts alongside their technical skills. This is a highly visible role where your work will directly shape pipeline generation, account prioritization, and the scalability of Vultr's GTM engine across our cloud compute and AI infrastructure selling motions. This is your opportunity to join our fast growing team and leave your mark on Vultr and the future of Cloud Infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own campaign execution end-to-end: Lead multi-channel GTM campaigns — including product launches, outbound plays, and ABM programs — across Salesforce, Lemlist, Salesloft, Email, LinkedIn Ads, Clay, and paid media platforms.

  • Build and maintain audience architecture: Manage segmentation, targeting, and campaign design using Clay, ZoomInfo, CRM queries, and web scraping to create accurate and scalable targeting segments for both GPU and CPU motions.

  • Engineer automated GTM workflows: Build and deploy automated workflows using Clay, Make.com, and n8n to streamline audience building, enrichment, lead routing, and scoring — integrating APIs across Salesforce, LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, and other GTM tools.

  • Write the copy that powers AI-generated outbound: Craft the base-layer sales emails, launch messaging, and outbound frameworks that AI personalization is built on — including positioning, hooks, and CTAs across segmentation variants and multi-touch sequences.

  • Maintain data quality and lead flow: Monitor and troubleshoot lead routing, enrichment syncs, and campaign data flow across Salesforce, Marketo, and enrichment systems. Own data hygiene, field accuracy, and proper attribution across every lead, contact, and account.

  • Activate signal-driven targeting: Leverage intent and signal data from 6sense, ZoomInfo, and HG Insights within Clay to identify and prioritize high-potential accounts. Continuously refine ICP definitions and lead scoring models using real-time engagement data.

  • Own attribution and pipeline reporting: Build and maintain standardized dashboards and reports segmented by campaign, channel, and opportunity. Connect campaign activity to leads, opportunities, and revenue with clear, consistent reporting.

  • Align with sales on outbound execution: Partner with SDR and Sales Ops teams to deliver campaigns through Salesloft and ensure adoption, consistency, and alignment across the outbound workflow.

  • Evaluate and implement emerging GTM tools: Research and assess new GTM and AI automation tools to improve outbound efficiency, personalization, and data accuracy — deploy AI-driven workflows that surface priority accounts and automate rep alerts.

  • Document and scale everything you build: Develop and maintain playbooks, runbooks, and process maps to ensure workflows are repeatable, scalable, and transferable across the team.

Qualifications

  • 4–7 years in B2B Marketing Ops, RevOps, or Growth roles bridging systems, automation, and campaign execution.

  • Proven success executing and optimizing demand generation and ABM programs across channels.

  • Core platform experience: Salesforce, Clay, Make.com, n8n; outbound platforms including Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist, Salesloft, Outreach; paid channels including LinkedIn Ads and Meta Ads.

  • Data flow & attribution: Strong understanding of routing logic and attribution modeling in CRM-centric environments.

  • B2B sales copywriting: Ability to write clear, compelling outbound email frameworks — hooks, positioning, CTAs, launch messaging — that serve as the foundation for AI-assisted personalization. Understands how tone, structure, and specificity affect deliverability and reply rates at volume.

  • Builder mentality: Bias for action, curiosity for new tools, and a love for clean, scalable systems.

  • AI & GTM experimentation: A passion for automation and experimentation — leveraging AI and data to make campaigns smarter, faster, and more impactful

Compensation

$120,000 - $140,000

Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws

Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

Position Overview

Dandy is seeking an Enterprise Account Manager to oversee and grow relationships with our largest and most strategic customers — multi-location dental groups, DSOs, and key enterprise accounts. You will serve as the primary partner to executive and clinical leaders, driving value across their organizations through consultative engagement, data-driven insights, and expansion strategies.

As the owner of a smaller, high-impact book of business, your primary goal is to increase average revenue per practice and retain the existing business by delivering exceptional customer experiences, identifying strategic growth opportunities, and aligning Dandy’s solutions to enterprise-level business objectives. You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, Product, and Support teams to ensure seamless execution and measurable results for our largest partners.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Account Management

  • Own a portfolio of Dandy’s largest, most complex customers (multi-location groups and enterprise accounts).
    Develop and execute strategic account plans to drive retention, expansion, and customer satisfaction.

  • Leverage data and performance metrics to identify trends, opportunities, and risks across your book of business.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to executive, clinical, and operational stakeholders, ensuring alignment between Dandy’s offerings and customer goals.

Commercial Growth

  • Identify and execute on upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities across locations and departments.
    Partner with enterprise procurement, operations, and finance teams to negotiate renewals and new commercial terms.

  • Lead conversations around scaling scanner deployments, doctor activations, and adoption of new Dandy products and services.

Customer Relationship Leadership

  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key stakeholders at top accounts.

  • Deliver strategic business reviews, performance insights, and partnership roadmaps to demonstrate ROI and strengthen collaboration.

  • Anticipate customer needs and lead proactive initiatives to prevent churn and accelerate growth.

Clinical & Operational Expertise

  • Develop a deep understanding of dental group operations, digital workflows, and the evolving competitive landscape.

  • Speak fluently in the language of clinicians and business operators to offer credible, tailored recommendations.
    Collaborate with Dandy’s product and clinical teams to provide feedback that drives innovation and customer success.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Support, Training, and Product to ensure seamless onboarding, implementation, and scaling.

  • Contribute insights from enterprise accounts to influence product roadmap and operational improvements.

  • Continuously experiment with engagement strategies, value frameworks, and communication approaches to enhance performance.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Enterprise Account Management, Customer Success, or Strategic Sales, ideally within the dental or healthcare technology industry.

  • Proven success managing and growing large, complex, multi-location customer accounts.

  • Strong commercial acumen with a track record of driving upsells, cross-sells, and renewals in enterprise environments.

  • Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, with experience engaging executive stakeholders.

  • Analytical and data-driven, with the ability to translate metrics into actionable insights.

  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and influencing cross-functional teams.

  • Highly motivated, performance-oriented, and passionate about improving the customer experience.

  • Willingness to travel about 40% for key customer meetings, industry events, and company offsites.

Req ID: J-1218

For full-time positions, Dandy offers a wide range of best-in-class, comprehensive, and inclusive benefits tailored to each country where we operate. Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Dandy also fully complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals. If you require any accommodations for your interview or have any questions beforehand, rest assured that we will do everything we can to meet your needs. Visit Dandy Careers for more!

You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your data at any time by contacting Privacy Requests.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

As Juniper Square's R&D organization grows globally, we're adding senior technical product leaders. We're looking for an experienced product manager who does well in technically complex problem spaces that cut across teams.

In this role, you will own capabilities that benefit teams across the company, where reaching our business goals depends on cross-functional collaboration and leadership. You'll shape the vision, turn it into a roadmap, and drive adoption across the organization, while holding a high bar for quality and security. You'll own a business or product domain end to end, with direct impact on Juniper Square's growth.

You'll bring a product mindset to everything you own and operate autonomously in a fast-growing, global R&D organization. In line with our values, you'll bring first-principles thinking to your domain and put clients first in every decision. You should be comfortable taking an active part in technical discussions and be curious about technical topics. Many people come to this role after working as engineers, but that isn't required.

We'll decide your specific area during the interview process, based on your experience and business priorities.

What you’ll do

  • Lead a large, technically complex product area: define success, prioritize problems and set strategy with the wider company in view

  • Identify the most significant near- and long-term opportunities in your area, and build consensus on how to sequence them against engineering capacity, risk and business priorities

  • Treat shared capabilities as first-class internal products, with clear documentation and a path teams can adopt instead of building their own

  • Set adoption and reliability expectations, and track how consistently teams build on shared capabilities

  • Bring tradeoffs such as build versus buy, technical debt and sequencing into architecture discussions with engineering leadership

  • Research and benchmark industry practices and new technology, including AI, and turn the findings into strategy

  • Build and maintain feedback channels with stakeholders inside and outside R&D, and use that input to prioritize

  • Define success metrics, track KPIs, and adjust strategy as you learn and as conditions change

  • Lead by influence: inspire other teams with your technical vision, earn their trust and drive adoption

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience as a product manager or in a similar role, with at least 5 years on technical platform, data or infrastructure products

  • Demonstrated experience owning horizontal shared capabilities used by multiple teams, with a focus on driving adoption

  • Demonstrated experience working on technically complex solutions, finding clean and enduring designs for these problems that scale

  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills, and comfort explaining complex technical concepts to a wide range of stakeholders within and outside the R&D organization

  • Track record of operating with high autonomy in ambiguous scope

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as an engineer

  • Concrete examples of using LLM-based agents to automate real-world workflows

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $230,000. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

  • Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

  • Life insurance

  • Mental wellness coverage

  • Fertility and growing family support

  • Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

  • Retirement saving plans

  • Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

  • Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

About your role

As a Senior Software Engineer at Juniper Square, you're a hands-on individual contributor who designs, builds, and operates production systems powering core workflows for institutional financial clients. You bring deep technical expertise to your team, drive complex projects independently, and collaborate closely with Staff engineers, product, design, and QA to ship reliable, well-designed systems.

You'll join the Platform team, building the foundational infrastructure layer that powers all AI work at Juniper Square, both customer-facing (GPX) and internal automation. Every AI initiative at JSQ runs on top of this platform, spanning AI Gateway & Infrastructure, Governance & Security, Retrieval & Data Access, and Agent Framework.

What you'll do

Build & Operate Production Systems

  • Design, build, and ship production-quality systems, APIs, and services - from foundational platform capabilities to customer-facing product experiences

  • Own projects end-to-end: translating requirements into technical designs, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing iteration

  • Build reliable, scalable, and observable systems that deliver value to customers and enable other engineering teams to move faster

  • Own the production health of the systems you build, including monitoring, troubleshooting, performance, reliability, and issue resolution

  • Build reusable infrastructure, frameworks, tooling, and developer experiences that enable teams across the organization

  • Improve engineering velocity and operational quality through automation, documentation, and continuous improvements

Drive Technical Excellence

  • Contribute to technical design for complex projects, evaluating tradeoffs and proposing pragmatic implementation plans

  • Partner with product, design, and engineering to translate requirements into well-designed technical solutions

  • Help identify and reduce technical debt, reliability risks, and friction in the software development lifecycle

  • Collaborate with Staff and senior engineers to establish reusable patterns and raise engineering standards

  • Participate in code reviews, design reviews, debugging, incident response, and operational support

AI Fluency & AI-Native SDLC

  • Use agentic coding tools and AI-assisted development as a primary part of your workflow, deliberately choosing where AI versus traditional software is the right tool

  • Critically evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, edge cases, and regressions, shipping quality output regardless of how it was produced

  • Build or integrate AI/LLM-powered capabilities in your domain where they add real value (e.g., evaluation frameworks, RAG pipelines, agentic workflows), with clear human-in-the-loop boundaries

  • Contribute to the team's evolving practices around AI-accelerated development, testing, and code review

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with product, design, QA, and cross-functional partners to meet timelines and align solutions to business goals

  • Provide clear, accessible technical context to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Domain Expertise

  • Grow into a subject-matter expert with a deep understanding of the data, workflows, and customer needs specific to that space

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of experience in backend and/or full-stack software engineering

  • Strong backend engineering experience with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Pyramid, or Django

  • Experience with relational/NoSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, and data modeling

  • Experience with cloud-native technologies such as AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes, and infrastructure as code

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD, observability, and operating services in production

  • Comfort working full-stack when the problem calls for it (TypeScript/React experience a plus)

  • Ability to break down complex technical problems and deliver pragmatic, maintainable solutions

  • Strong ownership mindset, with the ability to drive projects independently while collaborating effectively across teams

  • Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to engineering and cross-functional partners

  • Hands-on experience with AI-native development tools (e.g., Cursor, Augment), and demonstrated AI Fluency: a deliberate point of view on when AI is (and isn't) the right tool, adapted code review practices for AI-generated code, and safeguards against over-reliance on AI tooling

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent work experience

  • Hands-on experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered systems in production (e.g., RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, evaluation workflows, guardrails, prompt/tool orchestration, or model observability)

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-evolving technical territory where best practices and patterns are still being established

Nice to Have

  • Background in financial services or fintech

  • Experience with API gateway/infrastructure, security & governance tooling, retrieval and data-access systems, or agent frameworks at production scale

At Juniper Square, we believe building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture makes us a better company. If you think this role sounds like a fit, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $175,000 - $220,000 and the Canadian base salary range for this role is $165,000 - $210,000 CAD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

  • Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

  • Life insurance

  • Mental wellness coverage

  • Fertility and growing family support

  • Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

  • Retirement saving plans

  • Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

  • Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to lead the architecture and evolution of the core systems that power Juniper Square — the distributed services, cloud infrastructure, and developer platform on which every product, workflow, and AI capability is built. You will define the vision, architecture, operating model, and execution roadmap required to evolve from team-by-team infrastructure decisions to a cohesive, paved-road platform that enables every engineering team to ship reliable, secure, and performant software at speed.

This role anchors a strategic priority for our GPX line of business: taking Juniper Square upmarket to serve the largest private equity institutions in the world — firms managing $100B+ in AUM. Serving these PE titans demands a step-change in everything our systems do: order of magnitude increase in data and traffic volumes; enterprise-grade security, and integration expectations. You will architect the systems foundation that makes this scalable.

This is a deeply hands-on leadership role for a technical expert who leads by building: you will actively design systems, prototype solutions, write and review code, and guide teams through their most complex technical challenges.

Your mandate spans the full systems estate. You will modernize our service architecture and cloud foundation, define architecture across compute, networking, service communication, multi-tenancy, and observability, and build the systems substrate — including the infrastructure powering JunieAI and agentic workloads — on which teams across the business build and operate software. Throughout, you will hold our production systems to the availability, latency, security, and cost standards expected of a platform administering $300B+ in private markets assets.

You will work closely with engineering leadership, product teams, security, and executive stakeholders to align technology strategy with business outcomes, mentor engineers, and build a culture of operational excellence. Success in this role means not only delivering a modern systems platform but also elevating the team's capabilities, processes, and ways of working to operate as a true platform engineering organization.
While this is a remote role, some travel is required — to in-person leadership meetups, team offsites, and to customer sites in support of enterprise engagements where deep technical presence matters.

What you'll do

Architecture & Technical Leadership

  • Define and own the end-to-end systems architecture strategy across services, infrastructure, and developer platform

  • Designing frameworks and design patterns that accelerate the work of the rest of engineering org

  • Design scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems spanning synchronous APIs, asynchronous workflows, and event-driven architectures

  • Establish standards for service design, API contracts, multi-tenancy, and inter-service communication

  • Lead architecture reviews and technical decision-making for high-stakes, cross-cutting initiatives

  • Drive adoption of modern architectures (event-driven systems, platform engineering, infrastructure as code)

Hands-On Engineering

  • Design and prototype critical platform and infrastructure components

  • Write production-quality code for complex or high-impact areas

  • Review service designs, infrastructure changes, and performance-critical code paths

  • Troubleshoot performance, scalability, and reliability issues across services, queues, caches, and databases

  • Optimize workloads for latency, throughput, concurrency, and cost

Platform & Infrastructure Ownership

  • Design and architect a scalable cloud platform supporting compute, networking, storage, service orchestration, and deployment across all product lines

  • Build a paved-road developer platform — golden paths, internal tooling, CI/CD, and self-service infrastructure — that makes the right way the easy way

  • Create reusable platform primitives and internal APIs that product teams can compose rather than rebuild

  • Enable self-service infrastructure for engineering teams through standardized patterns, templates, and platform capabilities

  • Partner with AI workflow teams, product, and security teams to support production AI workloads, from inference pipelines to agent fleets

  • Design systems for safe agentic execution, including isolation boundaries, resource governance, auditability, and human-in-the-loop controls

  • Ensure reliability, scalability, and resilience of the platform, including high availability, monitoring, and disaster recovery readiness

Enterprise Scale & Upmarket Readiness

  • Architect core systems to handle the data volumes and structural complexity of $100B+ AUM managers: thousands of entities, tens of thousands of LPs, and deep multi-tier fund structures

  • Define scalability targets and re-architect bottlenecked systems ahead of demand, ensuring performance holds at 10x current transaction and data volumes

  • Design enterprise integration surfaces — APIs, bulk data interfaces, and ERP/GL connectivity — that fit into the existing technology estates of large institutional GPs

  • Meet the security, compliance, and operational diligence expectations of the largest PE firms, such as, SSO/SCIM, granular entitlements, audit trails, and data residency

  • Serve as the senior technical voice in enterprise sales and onboarding conversations where architecture, scale, and resiliency are decision criteria

Reliability & Operational Excellence

  • Lead incident response maturity: on-call practices, blameless postmortems, and systemic remediation

  • Drive capacity planning, load testing, and chaos/resilience engineering practices

  • Optimize cloud spend through architecture, workload placement, and continuous cost engineering

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Mentor senior engineers across platform, infrastructure, and product teams

  • Partner with product, data, and business teams to align systems investments with company outcomes — including the GPX upmarket expansion

  • Translate business and product requirements into scalable, operable system designs

  • Influence roadmaps using platform, reliability, and cost considerations

  • Act as the executive technical authority for systems architecture and production engineering

Culture & Enablement

  • Evangelize AI adoption, including AI-assisted engineering and operations

  • Help promote a culture of operational excellence and outcome-driven innovation

  • Become a role model for engineering excellence for the rest of the org

Qualifications

Required

  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

  • 15+ years in distributed systems, platform engineering, or infrastructure roles

  • Proven experience architecting large-scale, high-availability multi-tenant distributed systems in production

  • Strong hands-on experience with modern cloud-native stacks (Kubernetes, containers, service mesh, serverless)

  • Deep expertise in distributed systems fundamentals: consistency models, consensus, partitioning, idempotency, backpressure, and failure modes

  • Advanced proficiency in Python, Go, Java, or similar; strong systems-level debugging skills

  • Expertise in infrastructure as code (Terraform, Pulumi, or similar) and modern CI/CD

  • Experience designing event-driven and streaming architectures (Kafka or similar)

  • Experience building developer platforms, internal tooling, or paved-road infrastructure at scale

  • Strong understanding of observability practices and SRE principles (SLOs, error budgets, incident management)

  • Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP at production scale

  • Strong understanding of infrastructure security, multi-tenancy, and compliance best practices

  • Ability to operate at both executive and deeply technical levels

Nice to Have

  • Experience taking a SaaS platform upmarket to serve large enterprise or institutional customers

  • Background in private markets, fund accounting, or fintech systems with complex financial domain models

  • Experience building infrastructure for AI/LLM workloads: inference serving, agent runtimes, GPU scheduling, or evaluation systems

jobs.jobDescription:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the Role:

Veeam, following its acquisition of Securiti AI - the leader in AI-powered data security posture management (DSPM) - is seeking experienced Sales Specialists to drive growth in this innovative business.

In this role, you will focus exclusively on Securiti AI solutions, working closely with Veeam account executives to cross-sell into Veeam’s customer base, win new business, and expand existing Securiti AI accounts. You’ll have a shared territory with multiple AEs, strong earning potential, and support from a dedicated Securiti AI solution engineer for technical engagements. You’ll also benefit from Veeam’s robust go-to-market resources to ensure customer success.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute a territory plan to drive repeatable revenue within assigned accounts.
  • Collaborate with account executives to identify and maximize cross-sell opportunities for Securiti AI solutions.
  • Lead the entire sales process, serving as a trusted advisor, and presenting compelling business cases to customers.
  • Manage a pipeline of high-value opportunities, ensuring accurate forecasting and CRM discipline.
  • Expand relationships with key channel partners and resellers to accelerate deal flow and market reach.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven success closing complex enterprise software deals, with 10-15+ years in security software sales.
  • Extensive experience managing multithreaded sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong existing relationships with C-suite executives and channel partners in large enterprises.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise software sales, particularly in data security, management, or cybersecurity.
  • Reputation for integrity, honesty, and building long-term customer relationships.

#LI-JC3

What you'll get
