jobs.jobDescription:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

Location Requirement: Washington, D.C. metro area strongly preferred; other major federal markets considered.

Travel: Up to 60-75%, including customer, partner, and industry/policy engagements across the federal market.

About the Role

Veeam is expanding its Federal go-to-market strategy in advance of FedRAMP authorization, targeted by the end of calendar year 2026. The Principal Systems Engineer, Federal will serve as Veeam’s Federal Principal Technologist, acting as a technical evangelist and trusted advisor across the U.S. Public Sector.

This is not a traditional presales role. Operating ahead of the pipeline, you will engage agency executives, policy leaders, systems integrators, industry partners, analysts, and media to build technical credibility and cultivate champions who will help accelerate demand as Veeam’s federal business scales. Success in this role requires deep expertise in data protection, cyber resilience, and security, along with the executive presence to influence CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and mission leaders.

As the public face of Veeam’s federal technology strategy, you will evangelize the company’s four strategic pillars: Data Resilience, Cyber Resilience, Data & AI Trust, and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM). You will translate Veeam’s platform vision and DataAI Command Platform into compelling narratives that resonate with civilian, DoD, and intelligence community stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

  • Market & Technical Evangelism — Serve as Veeam's principal federal technical voice at industry events, agency briefings, partner forums, analyst engagements, and policy roundtables, articulating Data Resilience, Cyber Resilience, Data and AI Trust, and DSPM in terms that resonate with government audiences.
  • Executive & Policy Engagement — Build and maintain trusted relationships with agency C-level technology leaders (CIO/CISO/CTO), acquisition and policy leads, and mission owners, positioning Veeam's architecture and roadmap against their compliance, resilience, and modernization priorities.
  • FedRAMP Readiness Champion — Partner closely with Product, Security, Compliance, and Federal leadership to translate FedRAMP program status and controls into a clear, credible narrative for customers and partners, and to gather federal-specific requirements that inform authorization and roadmap priorities.
  • Partner & Alliance Enablement — Work with systems integrators, resellers, and strategic alliances (including Microsoft, hyperscalers, and federal-focused partners) to build joint federal narratives, reference architectures, and enablement content that scale Veeam's message across the partner ecosystem.
  • Securiti AI & Data Trust Champion — Champion Veeam's Securiti AI acquisition and the DataAI Command Platform as the foundation for federal DSPM, data curation, and responsible AI adoption, helping agencies connect Data Resilience, Cyber Resilience, and Data and AI Trust to their AI governance mandates.
  • Thought Leadership Content — Develop and deliver technical content — briefings, whitepapers, webinars, conference sessions, and executive-ready narratives — that establish Veeam as a credible, forward-looking authority across Data Resilience, Cyber Resilience, Data and AI Trust, and DSPM in the federal market.
  • Voice of the Field — Serve as the connective link between federal market signal and internal Product Management, Product Strategy, and Engineering, ensuring federal-specific requirements, competitive dynamics, and policy shifts inform roadmap and positioning decisions.
  • Sales & Alliance Support — Support high-priority federal opportunities and executive briefings on an as-needed basis, providing deep technical credibility to complement account teams without owning individual deal cycles.
  • VP, Federal Sales Partnership — Partner deeply with the VP of Federal Sales to align market-building activity to business outcomes — jointly setting priorities, translating evangelism and champion-building into account and pipeline strategy, and ensuring field, alliance, and marketing investments stay tied to revenue and authorization milestones.

Data Resilience, Cyber Resilience, Data and AI Trust & DSPM

This role requires deep expertise across Veeam’s four strategic pillars: Data Resilience, Cyber Resilience, Data & AI Trust, and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM), along with a strong understanding of the federal compliance landscape. You can credibly connect FedRAMP, FISMA, NIST 800-53, and Zero Trust requirements to modern data protection, immutability, ransomware recovery, cyber resilience, and DSPM capabilities, helping agencies understand the path to stronger security and operational resilience.

Equally important, you bring a clear point of view on Data & AI Trust in government, recognizing that resilient, well-governed data is foundational to successful AI adoption. You can translate that perspective into compelling content, thought leadership, and executive conversations that influence federal technology, security, and policy leaders.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in pre-sales systems engineering, solutions architecture, or technical evangelism, with significant exposure to U.S. Federal, DoD, or Public Sector markets.
  • Demonstrated experience engaging agency C-level technology leaders, policy leads, and acquisition stakeholders as a credible technical authority.
  • Working knowledge of federal compliance and authorization frameworks (FedRAMP, FISMA, NIST 800-53, Zero Trust) and how they shape technology adoption decisions.
  • Strong technical background across data resilience, data protection, backup/recovery architectures, virtualization, cloud, and security.
  • Proven public-facing presence — comfortable presenting at industry conferences, agency briefings, and partner/analyst events, and creating content (written and video) that carries a consistent point of view.
  • Foundational understanding of AI, data governance, and data security posture management (DSPM), with the ability to connect these concepts to federal mission and compliance priorities.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the polish to represent Veeam credibly in front of government executives and policy audiences.
  • S. citizenship required. Active TS or TS/SCI clearance strongly preferred; candidates must at minimum be able to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.
  • Self-directed operator who is comfortable building a market presence without a fixed pipeline of active deals — this is a build-the-market, not run-the-deal, mandate.

Bonus Skills

  • Existing relationships within federal civilian agencies, DoD, or the systems integrator community.
  • Prior experience with a vendor going through, or newly emerged from, FedRAMP authorization.
  • Experience with cloud platforms relevant to federal environments (AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, Google Cloud for Government).
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes-based and hybrid/multi-cloud architectures common in modernized federal environments.
  • Relevant industry or security certifications (e.g., CISSP, cloud, or architecture certifications).
  • A visible personal or professional brand in the federal IT, cybersecurity, or data resilience community (speaking engagements, publications, media presence).

Nice-to-Have Depth Areas

  • Data security posture management (DSPM) and data curation for AI/ML pipelines.
  • Cyber recovery and clean-room / isolated recovery environment (IRE) architectures.
  • Policy and regulatory engagement experience (e.g., participation in industry working groups, comment periods, or standards bodies).
  • Experience supporting capture and proposal teams on federal RFI/RFP responses.

#LI-TI1

What you'll get

  • Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day
  • Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
  • Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time
  • AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost
  • Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options
  • Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Compensation Transparency

Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range.

In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off.

U.S. Geographic Zones & Compensation Ranges (TTC / OTE)

Zone 1: San Francisco Bay Area, New York City Boroughs

$278,640—$517,440 USD

Zone 2: Washington, California (excluding San Francisco Bay Area)

$255,420—$474,320 USD

Zone 3: Texas, Illinois, North Carolina, Colorado, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Oregon, Nevada, Hawaii, New York (excluding NYC boroughs); Sales roles located in Georgia, Ohio, and Arizona

$232,200—$431,200 USD

Zone 4: All other US locations

$202,014—$375,144 USD

Veeam Software is an equal opportunity employer and does not tolerate discrimination in any form on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, age, national origin, citizenship, disability, veteran status or any other classification protected by federal, state or local law. All your information will be kept confidential.

Personal data collected during the recruitment process will be processed in accordance with our Recruiting Privacy Notice, which explains how your information is collected, used, and handled in connection with hiring activities. By applying for this position, you consent to this processing.

By submitting your application, you confirm that the information provided, including any supporting documents, is complete and accurate to the best of your knowledge. Any misrepresentation, omission, or falsification may result in disqualification from consideration or, if discovered after employment begins, termination of employment.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

We’re looking for a seasoned Senior Software Engineer, to help develop our rapidly growing platform for our Corporate organization. This team builds AI-enabled products and analytics experiences used by major US retailers and brands to better understand their shoppers, market share, and competitive positioning through our analytics portal and Insight Agent offerings. The ideal candidate possesses 7+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, strong experience building high-quality user experiences and scalable distributed systems, and 5+ years working with technologies such as Python, React, AWS, and modern data platforms. They should have a strong understanding of application architecture, APIs, observability, messaging and workflow patterns, and how infrastructure decisions impact the systems they build. They should also have hands-on experience building LLM-powered products and Agent Experiences, including designing Agent Loops, integrating MCP, and developing custom tools.

You'll be responsible for production AI Agent systems that our customers and internal teams depend on daily. That means being responsive, reliable, and an excellent communicator — both when things are going well and especially when they're not.

The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You've shipped full-stack applications, you're comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

As Our Senior Software Engineer You Will:

  • Own features and systems end-to-end for our Corporate Insight Agent — from requirements gathering and solution design through implementation, deployment, and iteration
  • Serve as a subject matter expert across the stack, reporting to the Head of Corporate Applications, who will provide hands-on mentorship in AI-native development, systems design, front-end development, and cloud infrastructure
  • Collaborate closely with Corporate Product Management and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, shape requirements, and revamp critical business processes
  • Drive initiatives proactively — you won’t be waiting for fully written specs; you’ll help define what gets built, why it matters, and how to execute effectively
  • Balance rapid prototyping and long-term engineering rigor, knowing when to build lightweight POCs to validate market fit versus scalable, maintainable production systems
  • Iterate closely with users and stakeholders, incorporating feedback quickly while maintaining a strong engineering bar for quality, reliability, and observability
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex to improve productivity and ship trustworthy solutions faster through strong engineering practices, code quality, and documentation

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 6+ years of hands-on software development experience with a proven track record of shipping customer-facing applications — and the impact to show for it
  • You have hands-on experience building production AI systems and a strong understanding of how to optimize AI agents for quality, reliability, latency, and cost
  • You are stack-flexible: comfortable working across TypeScript, Python, React, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure. You learn new tools quickly and don’t let unfamiliar technology slow you down
  • You have strong full stack engineering fundamentals, including experience building high-quality user experiences, scalable backend systems, observable services, and reliable workflows
  • You have an AI-accelerated workflow — you actively use AI coding tools to improve output and ship faster, not as an experiment, but as part of your day-to-day engineering practice
  • You are passionate about technology and continuously stay current with emerging trends, tools, and engineering practices that improve product quality, team velocity, and developer effectiveness
  • You care deeply about craftsmanship and user experience, with a passion for delivering polished, high-quality solutions that delight users
  • You are a strong communicator who can work directly with non-technical stakeholders, translate business needs into technical solutions, and clearly explain engineering tradeoffs
  • You are responsive and reliable — you take ownership of production systems and communicate proactively, especially under pressure
  • You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, STEM, or a related technical discipline

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. jobs.jobDescription:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

Ever dream about being in tech but aren’t quite ready to trade in your cowboy boots? Look no further than Halter! As the leading provider of virtual fencing technology, Halter is on a mission to enable 50% of the world’s landmass to be more productive and sustainable. This role is paramount for our growth aspirations and will enable us to continue making an impact on ranches across the US.

As a Territory Manager at Halter, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth and ensuring customer success within your designated territory. You will be responsible for executing sales strategies, building strong customer relationships, and meeting ambitious growth targets, all while acting as Halter’s on-the-ground representative. This role requires a proactive and hands-on approach, with a focus on both expansion and long-term customer satisfaction. In this role, you will prioritize daily efforts that optimize performance and drive value for your customers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, including Product, Support, and Customer Onboarding, you’ll share field insights to ensure Halter’s technology continues to meet the needs of US farmers.

Your day-to-day could include being on horseback, helping customers gather their cattle, on a side-by-side traversing their pastures, talking about how Halter could benefit their pastures, or attending industry events like CattleCon or your local Livestock Association meetups.

This role covers the Northern region of Arkansas. Frequent travel is required as apart of this role.

What your day could look like

  • Prospecting New Business: You’re driving up driveways, attending local cattle auctions, meeting with your local Livestock, Cattleman's, Stockman's associations, building your new business pipeline through outbound lead generation efforts. You’re fielding inbound leads in a timely manner, prioritizing administrative tasks with your in-field activities.

  • In-Field Sales: You don’t mind getting your hands and boots dirty. Halter is best discussed over a coffee at a kitchen table, in the horse saddle, or on a side-by-side in a pasture. You’re out on the ranch helping potential customers before diving into the value of Halter. You’re dropping off coffee during calving season. You value the magic moments that make all the difference to our customers.

  • Expanding Existing Opportunities: You’re always looking for new opportunities, and that includes expanding your existing customers with Halter. You find value in expanding relationships and finding new ways to increase value over time. Not every rancher will collar all of their cows, so you see this as a unique opportunity to meet your goals.

  • Hitting Sales Targets: High-growth sales targets don’t scare you; you step up to a challenge and like shooting high. You’re an expert pipeline manager and don’t second-guess unqualifying a lead. You’re able to manage today’s deals while keeping next month in your sights.

  • Customer Account Management: Building relationships is more than just making the sale to you. After the sale, you aim to maintain close relationships with your customers to ensure their ongoing satisfaction, provide support, and address any challenges they face with Halter’s products. You’ll also ensure a smooth handoff from sales to customer onboarding and deployment of Halter, helping customers get the most value from Halter’s solutions.

  • Territory Ownership: You have a high level of ownership and take pride in what you build. Owning an entire territory means giving treatment to every corner and leaving no stone unturned. You value being the face of your territory, meeting with high-level stakeholders from various local, state, and federal agencies to build lasting relationships with regional agricultural groups.

  • Customer Onboarding: Your high level of ownership doesn’t stop after the sale. You dive in to make sure your customers have the very best onboarding experience possible. You actively own the end-to-end customer experience during onboarding and deployment of Halter’s product, ensuring a smooth transition from sales to implementation even when you’ve handed off the customer to different teams across Halter.

  • Field Learnings & Feedback: Feedback is not only paramount to the companies you want to work for, but it’s also ingrained in how you would own your territory. Serving as the primary point of contact for gathering customer feedback in your territory, you work tirelessly to advocate for what your customers need.

  • Collaborating with Support Teams: You’re a natural collaborator, seeking out partners across Halter to resolve any issues your customers encounter, and quickly. You escalate problems as needed and ensure that customers in your territory feel fully supported.

  • Attending Industry Events: You leverage opportunities at relevant industry and Halter events to generate leads and deepen relationships with existing customers. You’ll participate in demonstrations and network to expand Halter’s influence in the market.

  • Contributing to the US Sales Strategy: You strongly believe that a team can only be stronger when they work together. You strive to work with the broader team to optimize and evolve the sales process, ensuring it fits the US market. As we scale, your input will help drive greater efficiencies.


You’ll be great if you exhibit

  • Driven Attitude & Communication skills: Results-driven, motivated, and adaptable, you excel in high-stakes environments. You’re well-prepared and skilled at communicating with customers and internal teams alike. You are proactive and do not wait to act.

  • Ranching / Cattle Experience: You know the ropes (and the reins) of ranching or cattle operations, understanding the unique challenges of the industry. This experience allows you to connect meaningfully with customers about what matters most.

  • Sales & Customer Success Expertise: You have a strong history of creating new business opportunities, negotiating a value-based sales conversation, and have a background in building lasting customer relationships. You build relationships versus transactional sales, aiming for the long-term success stories and can expand existing relationships through upsell opportunities.

  • Territory Management experience: Experience managing a large territory with a balanced focus on sales and customer success, ideally within agriculture or technology.

  • Problem Solving & Collaboration ability: Resourceful and quick-thinking, you work well with cross-functional teams to address challenges and drive solutions.

  • Willingness to Travel: Frequent travel within your territory to engage with customers and prospects.


Bonus things you could bring along to the role

  • Familiarity with precision agriculture or virtual fencing technologies.

  • Background in customer-facing roles within agriculture technology.

  • Background in selling software (SaaS) solutions in a B2B environment.


Our Benefits

  • Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual USD$750 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

  • Health Benefits - We offer best-in-class insurance for our employees, so they can care for themselves and their families.

  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave for primary and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers plus many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

  • Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

  • We're proud to offer 401k and make an employer match. We offer a 100% match on the first 3% you contribute, and a 50% match on the next 2%.

  • Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

The annual OTE salary range for this role is $140,000 - $165,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Halter and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and recently raised up to $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation over $1B.

We analyze billions of alternative data points every day to provide accurate, detailed insights on ridesharing, e-commerce marketplaces, payments and more. Our on-demand insights team uses proprietary technology to identify, license, clean and analyze the data many of the world’s largest investment funds and corporations depend on.

For three years and counting, we have been recognized as one of Inc’s Best Workplaces. We are a fast-growing technology company backed by The Carlyle Group and Norwest Venture Partners. Our offices are located in NYC, Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, Seattle, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, and Singapore. We cultivate a people-centric culture focused on mastery, ownership, and transparency.

About the Role:

YipitData is the leading alternative data platform for institutional investors, giving hedge funds and asset managers the differentiated insights they need to make better investment decisions. We are a multi-modal platform, inclusive of data feeds, our Investor Portal, and AI-powered agents and MCPs, that are redefining how investors discover, analyze, and act on data.

Product Marketing sits at the intersection of Product and Revenue, ensuring what we build, how we position it, and how we sell it are tightly aligned. As we expand into AI-native workflows, this function plays a critical role in shaping how our platform is understood, launched, and sold to increasingly sophisticated buyers.

We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to own that work for our Public Investor segment. You'll define positioning, lead product launches, and enable our commercial teams to bring the next generation of investor workflows to market. This is a foundational role with real scope, building core PMM capabilities for one of our most critical business lines. If you want to define how the future of investor workflows is understood and sold, this is your role.

Key Responsibilities of the Senior Product Marketing Manager

  • Own product positioning and go-to-market strategy for a new generation of AI and big data products, shaping how investors understand and adopt data feeds, the Investor Portal and AI-powered solutions like agents and MCPs
  • Define ideal customer profiles (ICPs) and tailoring messaging to different investor segments (e.g., hedge funds vs. long-onlys)
  • Partner with Product, Revenue, and Insights teams to influence roadmap decisions based on market demand and customer insights
  • Lead competitive intelligence across both traditional data providers and emerging AI platforms to define clear differentiation
  • Collaborate on pricing and packaging across a multi-product platform spanning data, software, and AI
  • Develop and scale high-impact sales enablement and marketing assets that help commercial teams communicate complex products with clarity
  • Establish and tracking success metrics for GTM efforts (e.g., adoption, pipeline impact, win rates) and iterating based on performance

Qualifications & Skills

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing or a related role, ideally working on B2B, data, or AI-driven products
  • Strong ability to translate complex, technical capabilities into compelling narratives
  • Interest in or experience with AI and data products, with excitement for shaping how they are adopted in high-stakes investor workflows
  • Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where the playbook is still being written
  • Experience working closely with product teams and influencing decisions early, not just at launch
  • Ability to operate both strategically and tactically, with ownership over outcomes end-to-end
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

Bonus Points if you…

  • Have experience working with hedge funds, asset managers, or financial data products
  • Have a background in finance, investing, or data-driven research
  • Have built or scaled product marketing in a B2B or data-driven environment
  • Are familiar with frameworks like positioning, ICP development, or Jobs-to-Be-Done
  • MBA or MS in Marketing

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, a competitive salary, and equity:

  • The annual base salary for this position is anticipated to be $160,000 - $185,000, with a 10% performance bonus, and equity.
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

We also have office hubs in Austin, Miami, Denver, Mountain View, and Seattle. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

Please note that for this position, we are not able to consider candidates who currently or in the future will require visa sponsorship.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.

About the Role

Hims & Hers is looking for a Manager, HRIS to own our Dayforce systems strategy. This role carries direct people-management responsibility for our HRIS Analyst (based in the Philippines) and serves as the final approver for sensitive configuration changes, escalations, and system decisions.

This is a systems role and a stakeholder role in equal measure. You will sit at the intersection of HR, Payroll, Finance, and IT, gathering requirements from business partners and translating them into practical, right-sized system solutions - not the most elaborate build possible, but the one that solves the actual problem. You will be measured as much on how proactively and clearly you communicate and how well you manage relationships across the business as on your technical command of Dayforce.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Dayforce systems strategy. Set direction for configuration of implemented modules (including Core HR and Time & Attendance), balancing stabilization needs against longer-term optimization and transformation priorities.

  • Manage the Dayforce HRIS Analyst. Directly manage the offshore HRIS Analyst, including workload prioritization, quality review, coaching, and performance management across a distributed, asynchronous working relationship.

  • Serve as final approver and escalation point. Retain approval authority for sensitive changes, ambiguous cases, and complex configuration decisions routed up from the analyst work queue.

  • Manage stakeholders proactively. Build and maintain trusted working relationships across HR, Payroll, Finance, and IT. Communicate status, risk, and trade-offs before being asked, not only when prompted.

  • Translate business requirements into MVP solutions. Partner with stakeholders to scope the smallest solution that meets the real business need, sequencing further enhancement deliberately rather than over-building on the first pass.

  • Govern integrations. Partner with IT and Security on integration and identity-provisioning issues, ensuring critical interfaces have clear ownership, monitoring, and escalation paths.

  • Oversee testing and UAT. Direct testing for system upgrades, releases, and new module rollouts, and ensure defects are logged, triaged, and resolved on schedule.

  • Maintain documentation as a single source of truth. Ensure business requirements, configuration workbooks, and process maps are kept current and are actually usable by the team.

  • Support global HRIS strategy. Partner with People Ops leadership on how international entities (currently on HiBob) fit into the broader HR systems landscape - including where integration with Dayforce makes sense and where the near-term goal is simply a reliable single source of truth for people data across systems.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on Dayforce administration and configuration experience, including meaningful ownership of at least one full implementation (required).

  • Demonstrated experience managing or mentoring direct reports, ideally including remote or offshore staff working across time zones.

  • Strong, proven stakeholder management skills - a track record of building trust across HR, Payroll, Finance, and IT, and of communicating proactively rather than reactively. This is a core requirement for this role, not a soft preference.

  • Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous business requirements into pragmatic, MVP-first technical solutions, with clear judgment about when to build now versus sequence for later.

  • Strong expertise in reporting, dashboards, and data analysis within Dayforce.

  • Experience supporting complex workforce environments (multi-location, high-volume, or multi-entity).

  • Strong working knowledge of core HR, payroll, and timekeeping processes and how they relate to system configuration and data.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the discipline to document decisions and keep stakeholders informed without prompting.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with disciplined attention to detail and accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience owning a Dayforce environment across the full arc from implementation through post-go-live stabilization and optimization.

  • Prior experience managing offshore or global-capability-center team members.

  • Familiarity with integrations, interfaces, SSO/identity provisioning, or data migrations, and the governance around them.

  • Experience executing formal UAT/regression testing and defect tracking programs.

  • Exposure to a healthcare, pharmacy, telehealth, or other regulated, high-volume environment.

  • Experience operating across more than one HRIS platform at once (e.g., following an acquisition or during a multi-entity rollout), including familiarity with HiBob or comparable systems.

ClickUp's mission is to make the world more productive. We help teams bring work together in one workspace so they can focus on meaningful outcomes. As an Senior Strategic Finance Specialist in FP&A, you'll partner with leaders across Sales, Ecosystem, and Revenue Operations. You'll build the forecasts, models, and analysis that help these teams understand performance, make investments and decisions, and grow efficiently.

The Role

  • Partner with Sales, Ecosystem, and Revenue Operations to understand business priorities and translate them into financial forecasts and analysis.

  • Build and maintain financial models and forecasts that help GTM leaders evaluate plans, assumptions, performance, and investment choices.

  • Own recurring reporting, explain material trends or variances, and make the financial story clear to business partners.

  • Investigate ad hoc questions behind the numbers and turn the findings into practical recommendations for target attainment and efficient growth.

  • Work with stakeholders to validate assumptions, improve the clarity and consistency of reporting, and support sound day-to-day decisions.

Required Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of experience in FP&A, strategic finance, financial analysis, or a related analytical role, with examples of supporting business decisions.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and building AI-powered workflows to streamline financial analysis, reporting, or forecasting, with the ability to validate outputs for accuracy and translate results into actionable business insights

  • Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and spreadsheet skills, including the ability to organize data and check work for accuracy.

  • Experience producing recurring reporting or variance analysis and explaining what the results mean for the business.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to make complex financial information understandable to non-finance partners.

  • Strong judgment, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple requests in a collaborative, fast-moving environment.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS or technology teams, especially across multiple go-to-market functions.

  • Familiarity with financial planning systems or analytics tools such as Pigment, Adaptive, Anaplan, SQL, or business intelligence platforms.

  • Experience assessing resource allocation, investment choices, or the relationship between operating metrics and financial results.

Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About Out Summer Internship Program

Our Summer Internship Program is designed for students entering their final year of university who are eager to gain meaningful, real-world experience in a fast paced, collaborative, and professional environment.

As a Summer Intern, you'll participate in a comprehensive onboarding experience led by our University Relations team to set you up for success from day one. Throughout the program, you'll also have the opportunity to participate in weekly professional development sessions, networking events, social activities, and other engaging experienced designed to support your personal and professional growth.

The program takes place from June – August 2027 (10-week program).

Role Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and test features related to Kasten by Veeam's product K10 in the area of cloud native backup and disaster recovery
  • Preparation of design documents and use them to conduct design reviews with the team
  • Preparation of test plans for testing features and present the test plan to the team
  • Design and development of CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous deployment) test pipelines meant for testing features.

Qualifications

  • Pursuing a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Interest in developing, testing, and debugging production-quality, scalable, multithreaded, concurrent systems
  • Interest in distributed systems, concepts and client-server architectures
  • Strong computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, and concurrency)
  • You are passionate about code quality, extensibility, coding standards, testing, and automation
  • You are impact and result-driven

Nice To Have

  • Interest in developing in Go
  • Interest in databases and/or storage systems - especially in the public cloud
  • Interest in developing for and on containers, container scheduler, and orchestration platforms
  • Interest in participating and contributing to open source

Benefits

As a paid intern at Veeam, you’ll receive:

  • Paid Company Holidays during your internship
  • Tech Stipend to help set up your workspace
  • 8 Hours of Paid Volunteer Time through our Veeam Cares Program
  • Personal and Professional Development through our Internship Program

We’re committed to providing a supportive and rewarding internship experience.

The pay range posted is an hourly rate of base pay. When making an offer of employment, Veeam will take into consideration the candidate’s expectations, experience, education, scope of responsibility for the role, and the current market demands.

$40 - $50 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

We are seeking a Senior Payroll & Benefits Administrator to own our US payroll operations and support the financial and administrative components of our benefits programs. You’ll be responsible for accurate and timely payroll for 500+ employees, multi-state payroll compliance, benefits invoice reconciliation, and the payroll and reconciliation processes associated with our self-insured health plans.

This is a highly hands-on role that will partner closely with Finance, People Ops, ADP, and our benefits partners. You’ll serve as an internal payroll subject matter expert while helping us strengthen controls, improve processes, and scale our payroll and benefits operations as the company grows.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

We expect East Coast work hours.

As Our Senior Payroll & Benefits Administrator You Will:

  • Own end-to-end US payroll processing 500+ US employees, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll.
  • Partner with Finance and People Ops to manage payroll inputs and changes, including new hires, terminations, compensation changes, bonuses, deductions, and leaves, proactively identifying and resolving discrepancies.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact and internal subject matter expert for payroll, resolving employee questions and partnering with ADP and internal stakeholders on payroll, tax, and deduction issues.
  • Manage multi-state payroll and tax requirements for a distributed workforce, including appropriate handling of New York's Convenience of the Employer rule and related withholding requirements.
  • Own payroll and invoicing-related benefits administration, including employee deduction changes, QLEs, and ongoing coordination with the People Ops benefits team.
  • Review and reconcile benefits invoices and self-funded plan activity, validating employee eligibility, enrollment, payroll deductions, and plan fees, and partner with Accounting to resolve discrepancies and complete financial reconciliations.
  • Own payroll and benefits reconciliations and support month-end, year-end, W-2 preparation, open enrollment, benefits renewals, audits, and other recurring processes.
  • Maintain strong documentation and controls while identifying opportunities to automate, simplify, and scale payroll and benefits processes.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 4+ years of hands-on payroll and benefits administration experience, including direct responsibility for running payroll through ADP Workforce Now for a US workforce of at least 500 employees and managing multi-state payroll. Experience reconciling benefits invoices is required; experience with self-insured benefits plans and New York's Convenience of the Employer rule is strongly preferred.
  • You have strong working knowledge of federal, state, and local payroll and tax requirements and are comfortable researching and resolving complex payroll and withholding questions.
  • You have hands-on experience with benefits administration and invoice reconciliation and can confidently identify discrepancies across payroll, HRIS, carrier, and vendor data.
  • You are highly proficient with Excel or Google Sheets and comfortable working with large datasets, reconciliations, audits, and reporting.
  • You are exceptionally detail-oriented and take ownership of high-stakes, deadline-driven work, building appropriate checks and controls into your processes.
  • You are a clear, empathetic communicator who can independently own recurring processes, exercise good judgment, and continuously look for ways to make payroll and benefits administration more efficient, scalable, and reliable.

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
  • Base Salary Only: The annual base salary range for this position is anticipated to be $105,000-115,000. Final compensation may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant’s experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and internal team benchmarks.
  • The compensation package also includes equity.

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. If the remote work is performed outside of these offices, income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Halter

At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out-think, out-work and out-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world - this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.

We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.

To find out more, visit our LinkedIn & Instagram.

About the role

As a Regional Sales Lead (Kansas) at Halter, you will lead a team of Territory Managers on the front lines of transforming livestock management across the U.S. This is a deeply hands-on role: you’ll spend most of your time in the field coaching reps, joining customer conversations, and removing barriers to their success.

You’ll shape regional performance, uphold rigorous pipeline and Salesforce standards, and ensure your team executes with consistency and excellence. We’re looking for a leader who brings energy, high standards, and a strong sense of culture. Someone who cares about people, thrives in fast growth, and can operate equally well in strategy discussions and day-to-day execution.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach & develop Territory Managers through frequent in-field work (~60% travel), ongoing feedback, role-plays, and hands-on sales training to ensure strong execution and skill development.

  • Own regional revenue performance by driving consistent activity, supporting both new sales and account expansion, and ensuring TMs meet input and output targets.

  • Maintain world-class Salesforce hygiene & forecasting, reviewing pipelines weekly, ensuring accurate data, and acting as deal support on structure, escalations, and critical opportunities.

  • Serve as the regional voice - surfacing customer insights, product feedback, and operational issues to Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer teams, and broader leadership.

  • Localize national strategy into regional execution plans, run lightweight team rhythms (1:1s, check-ins), and align closely with U.S. commercial leadership on performance and priorities.

  • Recruit and develop high-performing talent, helping scale Territory Manager teams as Halter grows rapidly across the U.S.

What you’ll bring

  • Strong Frontline Sales Leadership: Experience leading and developing field sales reps, ideally in high-growth or high-velocity environments, with a track record of coaching reps to consistently improve performance.

  • Hands-On, Field-First Mindset: Comfortable spending the majority of your time on the road - joining customer visits, modeling best practices, and staying deeply connected to real-world customer challenges.

  • Expertise in Sales Process & Methodology: Proficiency in modern sales practices (e.g., consultative/challenger sales models, role-plays, discovery techniques) and the ability to coach Territory Managers to master them.

  • Pipeline, Salesforce, & Forecasting Discipline: Strong operational rigor with CRM hygiene, pipeline management, input metrics, and forecasting accuracy - especially important in a hardware + software environment.

  • Direct, Supportive People Leadership: A leadership style built on clarity, accountability, empathy, and high support - someone who cares deeply, sets high expectations, and builds strong team culture.

  • Comfort With Ambiguity & Fast Growth: Thrives in dynamic, evolving environments; adaptable, resourceful, and motivated by building systems, processes, and habits in a rapidly scaling U.S. business.

Our Benefits

  • Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual USD$750 self-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.

  • Health Benefits - We offer best-in-class insurance for our employees, so they can care for themselves and their families.

  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave for primary and 8 weeks for secondary caregivers plus many other parental benefits that support you and your family.

  • Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.

  • We're proud to offer 401k and make an employer match. We offer a 100% match on the first 3% you contribute, and a 50% match on the next 2%.

  • Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.

The annual OTE salary range for this role is $200,000 - $225,000. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Halter and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location.

Join our team

Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!

If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!

Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn & Instagram.

Why our team loves working at Halter:

  • Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.

  • Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.

  • You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our personal growth fund.

  • This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

jobs.jobDescription:
Hims & Hers is the leading health and wellness platform, on a mission to help the world feel great through the power of better health. We are redefining healthcare by putting the customer first and delivering access to care that is affordable, accessible, and personal, from diagnosis to treatment to delivery. No two people are the same, so we provide access to personalized care designed for results. By normalizing health & wellness challenges and innovating on their solutions, we’re making better health outcomes easier to achieve.

Hims & Hers is a public company, traded on the NYSE under the ticker symbol “HIMS.” To learn more about the brand and offerings, you can visit hims.com/about and hims.com/how-it-works . For information on the company’s outstanding benefits, culture, and its talent-first flexible/remote work approach, see below and visit www.hims.com/careers-professionals.

About the Role

Hims & Hers is looking to hire a Senior Manager of Planning Systems to join our Strategic Finance organization. Reporting to the VP, FP&A, you will own the architecture behind the company's consolidated planning and reporting cycles and lead a small team responsible for how inputs from across the FP&A pillars flow into a coherent, system-based corporate view that informs decisions made by senior leadership, the executive team, and the Board.

This is a player-coach role for someone who pairs strong financial and business acumen with deep experience in planning tools and finance transformation. You will stay hands-on in the model and the data while managing and developing a team of analysts, owning the planning systems roadmap, and setting the standard for how planning and reporting scale across the broader FP&A team. We're looking for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, high-growth environment and gets energy from building durable infrastructure and the people who run it.

You Will

  • Lead, hire, and develop a team of 1–2 analysts to lead finance transformation efforts across finance and accounting, spanning planning systems, consolidation, and executive reporting, setting clear priorities and a high bar for accuracy and timeliness

  • Own the consolidated planning and reporting engine behind the annual operating plan, long-range plan, and monthly/quarterly forecast cycles, covering data intake, consolidation, and on-time delivery of the outputs reviewed by senior leadership, and lead its evolution into a scalable, system-based architecture

  • Serve as the functional and technical owner of the financial planning platform, leading EPM tool evaluation and selection, design, implementation, enhancement, administration, and team enablement

  • Own the planning systems roadmap end-to-end, including prioritization, sequencing against the planning calendar, governance, and change management, and communicate progress and trade-offs to Finance leadership

  • Design data flows and integrations connecting the planning platform to the ERP, data warehouse, and BI stack, partnering with Accounting, Data Engineering, Data Science and Analytics on architecture and data ownership

  • Support executive-facing financial deliverables, including the Weekly Business Review, monthly OpEx review, and quarterly Board and Audit Committee materials, and build dashboards and reporting that surface KPIs and business insights with minimal manual assembly

  • Partner with category, marketing, and ops finance leads to standardize how their inputs are gathered, pressure-tested, and consolidated into a single corporate view

  • Establish and enforce best practices across systems controls, data governance, and planning process documentation

You Have

  • B.S. in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or equivalent experience

  • 8+ years of progressive experience spanning strategic finance / FP&A and finance systems or finance transformation roles, including 2+ years managing or formally developing analysts

  • Strong financial and business acumen, including command of P&L mechanics, budgeting, forecasting, and the consolidation mechanics behind a company-wide planning cycle

  • Hands-on experience implementing, administering, or owning an EPM / planning platform (Anaplan, Pigment, Adaptive, Planful, or similar), including model design and integrations

  • Demonstrated success leading a finance transformation initiative end-to-end, standing up or materially scaling planning systems and automated reporting, not just contributing components

  • Ability to manipulate large datasets and translate them into clear, structured, decision-ready outputs

  • Strong project management instincts, with the ability to run multiple workstreams simultaneously and delegate effectively

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical audiences, from system administrators to the executive team

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with a bias toward action in ambiguous, fast-changing environments

  • Track record of leveraging AI and automation to improve finance workflows

Nice to Have

  • Proficiency with SQL and experience with BI tools (Looker); NetSuite or similar ERP integration experience

  • Experience at a high-growth public company (recent IPO) or late-stage startup (Series C+) that has scaled through significant revenue and organizational growth

  • Exposure to a public company's external reporting cycle (Board, Audit Committee, earnings/guidance)

Our Benefits (there are more but here are some highlights):

  • Competitive salary & equity compensation for full-time roles

  • Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental & vision, and parental leave

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP)

  • 401k benefits with employer matching contribution

  • Offsite team retreats

We are committed to building a workforce that reflects diverse perspectives and prioritizes ethics, wellness, and a strong sense of belonging. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match.

jobs.jobDescription:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Position Overview

The Vice President, Product helps raise the quality, speed, and ambition of product development across the Cordance portfolio. This is not a traditional single-company VP of Product role. The VP partners with BU Presidents, Product leaders, and Engineering teams to strengthen product strategy, improve the quality of major product bets, and help our businesses build products that drive growth, retention, and long-term value. The mandate spans executive advisory work on major product decisions, raising product capability and craft across the portfolio, and helping teams use AI to rethink both what they build and how they build it.

Success in this role means our businesses make better product choices, validate ideas earlier, build faster, and put more of their product and engineering capacity behind the opportunities most likely to improve customer value and business performance. It also means our Presidents and Product leaders become stronger product thinkers, and our best product practices spread more quickly across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with BU Presidents and Product Leaders
    • Help Presidents and Product leaders turn customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities into clear product strategies and roadmaps.
    • Challenge assumptions on product-market fit, differentiation, prioritization, and investment before major decisions are made.
    • Help teams move beyond feature roadmaps toward stronger customer-, market-, and outcome-based product decisions.
    • Get directly involved in important product decisions where additional product leadership can materially improve the outcome.
  • Improve the Quality of Product Bets
    • Assess major product bets on customer value, market opportunity, differentiation, expected business impact, required investment, and execution feasibility.
    • Help teams determine where to invest, test, accelerate, modernize, or stop.
    • Bring rigor to early product validation so teams learn quickly before committing significant engineering capacity.
    • Connect product decisions to measurable results, including adoption, retention, expansion, ARR growth, and customer value.
  • Build Products in the AI Age
    • Help teams identify AI-native opportunities rather than simply adding AI features to existing products.
    • Apply AI across discovery, prototyping, validation, development, testing, launch, and ongoing optimization.
    • Help Product and Engineering teams use AI-assisted development to improve speed and time to market.
    • Bring practical fluency in AI-enabled UX, automation, agentic workflows, data, model economics, security, and privacy.
    • Ensure AI investments are grounded in real customer and business outcomes, not novelty.
  • Raise Product Capability Across the Portfolio
    • Coach senior Product leaders and PMs to become better product and business leaders.
    • Strengthen discovery, prioritization, MVP definition, roadmap strategy, experimentation, and product measurement.
    • Establish a small number of practical product standards and operating rhythms that improve execution without slowing teams down.
    • Identify common capabilities, tools, and patterns that can be leveraged across businesses where it makes sense.
    • Introduce current SaaS and AI product thinking while respecting the unique markets and customer needs of each business.
  • Connect Product, Engineering, and Business Strategy
    • Work closely with Engineering leaders so product strategy and technical decisions reinforce one another.
    • Engage credibly on SaaS architecture, cloud, APIs, data, platforms, AI, and scalability.
    • Help teams think clearly about build, buy, partner, and platform choices.
    • Maintain a strong customer and business orientation while working across technical and commercial teams.

Competencies:

  • Product Judgment – Identifies important customer problems, validates opportunities, and makes clear prioritization decisions.
  • Builder Mindset – Creates and improves products rather than simply managing roadmaps or large Product organizations.
  • AI-Native Thinking – Sees where AI changes what gets built and how teams build it, and focuses on value over novelty.
  • Commercial Fluency – Connects product decisions to adoption, retention, expansion, monetization, and ARR growth.
  • Influence Without Authority – Earns credibility with CEOs, Presidents, and Product leaders and influences through expertise and judgment.
  • Leader Development – Coaches senior Product leaders and PMs to become stronger product and business leaders.
  • Technical Credibility – Engages effectively with Engineering while remaining fundamentally customer- and product-led.
  • Bias for Outcomes – Values judgment, speed, and measurable results over process for its own sake.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant B2B SaaS product leadership experience, including leading products from early concept through launch and scale.
  • Demonstrated success creating and improving products, not simply managing roadmaps or large Product organizations.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI to both product development and customer-facing products.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS economics, including adoption, retention, expansion, monetization, and growth.
  • Experience working directly with CEOs, Presidents, or senior business leaders.
  • Experience coaching and developing senior Product leaders and PMs.
  • Technical fluency in SaaS architecture, cloud, APIs, data, platforms, and scalability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working across multiple products, markets, or businesses.
  • Portfolio, multi-business, or PE-backed operating experience.
  • Vertical SaaS experience.

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.

Why Join Us?

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

  • Health and Wellness:
    • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
  • Retirement Savings:
    • 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
    • RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
  • Paid Time Off:
    • Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
  • Parental Leave:
    • 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
  • Remote Work Support:
    • Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
  • Holidays:
    • Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

EEOC & ADA Statement:

If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact Human Resources.

This applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Final candidate must be able to pass a background check.
